title: feat(grid): read-only cells say so in the grid, a cell save is said in one live region, a touch never edits in place (#35689 slice A)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XURgXCZHcjPoyo5g9cMEATi)_

Part of #35689 — slice A (touch, accessibility, checked rows). Slice B (a row moving to its new group, group subtotals and the footer total refreshing after a save) stays on the card for its own PR.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 平板上点列表的一行只会打开记录，不会误进格子编辑；读屏软件移到不能改的格子会读出「只读」（审批锁在选中后才查到时也会立刻读出），格子保存后会读出「已保存：字段名」，失败时读出原因；其余用户无感。
- 列表行内编辑重做专题的收尾（无障碍与触屏部分），分组移动与合计刷新另开一个 PR。
- 出错时最坏是读屏软件少读或多读一句、平板上点到编辑按钮没反应，不影响保存的数据；可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

Measured on `origin/main` before any edit (the dispatch's six mechanism assumptions):

1. **Touch.** A touch tap on a cell opens the record and never selects or edits (`isTouchPress`, from #35684): holds, pinned. One gap measured: a lookup cell's edit button (the pencil) is drawn at `opacity-0` once any pointer enters the cell and is still hit-testable, so a tap on the right edge of an unselected lookup cell landed on the invisible button and **opened the editor in place**. Fixed in `CellEditButton`: a finger entering an unselected cell does not draw the button, and a touch click on one drawn earlier for a mouse does nothing (the row ignores a click on a button). The press is read by its own click only, then cleared, so a later click with no pointer of its own (assistive tech) edits as before. The explicit edit entry on touch is the record page (a tap beside the button opens it), per the card's 「通过记录页或显式的编辑入口」.
2. **`aria-readonly`.** Absent. Now, only when the table is `role="grid"`, a data cell that opens no editor carries `aria-readonly="true"`, and so does the type-catcher input that holds focus in the selected cell (the element a screen reader lands on). Every cell reads the table's own facts (`editable`, the column, `isRowEditable`); the selected cell adds the host's (`describeCell`). The host's answer is **asked as the cell becomes selected and kept in state** (`selectedHostReadOnly`), asked again only when the selected row is re-read or the host hands the table a new `GridCellSelection` value, so it is not asked per render for a host whose value is stable. `describeCell`'s TSDoc now says exactly that: asked when the reader acts on a cell, once as a cell becomes selected, and again when its row is re-read or the provider's value is a new object; the value's identity is part of the contract, so a host keeps it stable (memoised) or the selected cell is asked on every render.
   - In the list (`ObjectGrid`), the host value is now memoised on what its cell facts read (fields, object, permissions, the view's `editable`, the update verdicts, the approval locks, the page's record ids, the language), so it is new only when an answer can have changed; the commit question and the chip opener read the latest render through a ref.
   - `useRowApprovalLocks` re-renders its host when a lock read answers (and when the answers are dropped on an invalidation): `isLocked` and the hook's value are new exactly then. So a lock answered after the select-time ask is said on the selected cell at once, without the reader moving, both ways (locked by the service, or a pending `approval_status` the service says is not locked).
3. **Live region.** Before: a per-cell `role="status"` span mounted with its state, its words only in `aria-label`, plus `role="alert"` on failure. A region that mounts with its content is often not announced, and a label is not live content. Now one persistent visually hidden `aria-live="polite"` region per table that saves per cell (`autosaves`), drawn for the table's whole life; a successful save writes "Saved: COLUMN" into it (new key `table.cellSavedAnnouncement`, all eleven packs), each saying in a node of its own so the same words twice are said twice. Cells saved together are joined with the pack's list punctuation (`validation.formInvalidJoiner`, the key the form's field lists use: `、` in ja and zh), and a column with no header is never named by its key (the region then says `table.cellSaved`, "Saved"). A failure stays with the existing cell alert, said once; the region drops the earlier "saved". The per-cell mark becomes `role="img"` with its existing label: named, never live, so no duplicate announcement.
4. **Focus after a picker panel closes** (`placement="below"`): measured, it already returns to the cell by Esc and by a pick (`focusSelectionRef`, #35688). Pinned, no source change.
5. **Selection frame contrast** (`border-2 border-primary`, WCAG 1.4.11, 3:1 needed): passes everywhere, no change. Token arithmetic (sRGB relative luminance) on the shipped themes:
   - Console light (`--primary` 211 100% 50% on `--background` white): 3.97; on the hover row (muted/40) 3.74; on a checked row (primary/5) 3.73; on a checked hovered or active-record row (primary/10) 3.49; on full muted 3.40.
   - Console dark (211 100% 60% on 240 6% 6%): 6.34; hover 5.83; checked 6.03; checked hover/active 5.67.
   - `@object-ui/components` default theme: 17.84 light, 19.09 dark, at least 14.53 on any row state.
6. **Selection.** `commitCellValue` stages one cell and never reads `selectedRowIds`; `selectionResetKey` moves only on bulk actions and refresh: holds, pinned.

### Review round (L1 7076074435, L2 7076070602)

| Item | Resolution | Commit |
|:---|:---|:---|
| S1 (L1, L2): `describeCell` asked per render | Asked at selection, kept in state; re-asked only on a re-read row or a new host value; `ObjectGrid`'s value memoised so it is new only when its facts can change. TSDoc kept as is. | `1733276c`, `6bc85294` |
| S2 (L2): a lock answered after the select-time probe | `useRowApprovalLocks` re-renders on an answer; re-applied on main's batched lock read (#36295) in the merge | `1733276c`, `65b9199f` |
| N1: touch-tap comment, `pressedByRef` never reset | Comment says the tap does nothing on the button; the press is cleared by the click that reads it | `1733276c` |
| N2: hard-coded `', '`, raw `accessorKey` | `validation.formInvalidJoiner`; a header-less column is left unnamed | `1733276c` |
| N3: claim's file surface | The final file surface is in the dev report for the seat to amend the claim | report |
| L1-d 7078101760 item 1, L2 R1 (7077725274): TSDoc still said "never per render" | `describeCell` TSDoc says when the table asks it and that the provider value's identity matters; the two data-table comments that echoed it aligned | `69919545` |

## Tests

New card-named describes, each in the component's existing harness file:

- `data-table-select-first-35684.test.tsx`: a touch tap opens the record and a touch double-tap neither selects nor edits; a tap on an unselected lookup cell's edit button edits nothing (control: the mouse's click edits); after such a tap, a click with no pointer of its own edits; the selected read-only cell carries `aria-readonly` on the cell and its focus, an editable one none; **the host's facts are asked as the cell is selected and not again across three re-renders, and a new host value is asked again and turns `aria-readonly` on where the selection is**; a table that edits nothing marks every cell; control: outside the grid no `aria-readonly`.
- `data-table-autosave-35685.test.tsx`: the region is there and silent before any save, says "Saved: Name" after one, a second saying is a new node, saving is not said, and the table holds exactly one live element; cells saved together read `已保存：Stage、Name` in zh; a header-less column reads "Saved"; a refused save is said by the cell alert alone and the region empties; control: no region without per-cell save. With two rows checked, a cell edit sends one update of that one cell and both checks stay.
- `data-table-keys-35687.test.tsx`: a picker panel under the cell hands focus back to the cell on Esc and on a pick.
- `ObjectGrid.cellSelection-35684.test.tsx`: with the page's lock read held open, a row the service says is locked turns `aria-readonly` on once the read answers, and a row whose `approval_status` stands in as locked turns it off once the service says it is not, both while the cell stays selected.

## Acceptance notes

- Not done here, by the card's split: slice B (a row moving to its new group after a save, group subtotals and the footer total refreshing) follows on its own PR.
- `aria-readonly` on cells other than the selected one reads the table's own facts only (`editable`, the column, `isRowEditable`); the host's per-cell facts (`describeCell`: field read-only, permission, approval lock) are asked of the selected cell alone, because the table asks `describeCell` only at the moments its TSDoc names, never for every cell. A screen reader moving cell to cell always lands on the selected cell, so the acceptance line holds; a reader browsing the table in its virtual mode hears the coarser answer on cells it does not select.
- While the selected row's lock read is on the wire, the selected cell's `aria-readonly` reads the `approval_status` column (the hook's fail-open stand-in) and changes when the read answers; Enter or F2 in that window waits for the read (#36295) and says the reason.
- The `ObjectGrid` memo is not pinned by a test of its own (its call count is internal to the host); the table-level pin holds the table to "never per render" for any host whose value is stable.
- "A touch never edits in place" is a fact of the select-first model (`cellSelection`): there a click only selects, so `singleClickEdit` is never read, and the touch pins in `data-table-select-first-35684.test.tsx` already run with `singleClickEdit: true`. `ObjectGrid` passes `singleClickEdit: schema.singleClickEdit ?? true` on main today; #36357 (read at `579f99ae`) also edits `ObjectGrid.tsx` (`hostCellSelection = cellSelectionProp ?? inlineEditable`, `singleClickEdit: true`) and `ObjectGrid.cellSelection-35684.test.tsx`; it makes every grid that renders editable select-first, so this behaviour extends to them and no pin here flips; `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --pr=36357` on 69919545: merges cleanly, VERDICT clean. The one residual is a host passing `cellSelection={false}` explicitly (none in-tree). A grid on the older click-to-edit model (no `cellSelection`, `singleClickEdit` true) still edits on a touch tap, as it did before this PR; that model is outside this slice.
- A tap that lands on a lookup cell's edit button drawn earlier for a mouse (a hybrid device) now does nothing at all rather than editing; the row's click handler ignores clicks on buttons, so the tap does not open the record either. A finger alone never draws the button.
- Real screen-reader output (VoiceOver, NVDA) and a real iPad were not exercised; the pins are jsdom, and the claim about a region that mounts with its words is the general live-region behaviour, not a measurement here.
- Selection frame contrast: no change needed; the readings are in What changes.

## Verification

Read first (risk order):
1. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`, the `gridCellSelection` memo and its dependency list: a missing dependency would leave the selected cell's `aria-readonly` stale until the reader moves (act-time reads stay fresh either way).
2. `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`, the `selectedHostReadOnly` layout effect and the `cellReadOnly` line in the body-cell map.
3. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/hooks/useRowApprovalLocks.ts`, the `answerSeq` bump in the read's `finally` and on the invalidation reset.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.cellSelection-35684.test.tsx`, expect every test passing, among them the two in "the selected cell says a lock that answers after it was selected (objectstack#35689)".
